question: Which first row in the pre-frozen six-family queue supplies three references, a consecutive query triplet and an observable same-scene sibling before RGB/model access?

source.resume: A fully downloaded file may be reused only after JSON or ZIP integrity validation; incomplete .part files are deleted and restarted. Network failure pauses without a source conclusion and does not advance the queue.

reference_memory.vacancy_fill: If positive-marginal selection stops at two, fill one remaining admitted reference by maximum minimum camera-to-target angle.

query_triplet.selection: Maximize minimum visible target vertices, then total visible vertices, minimum short-side fraction, minimum depth-visible ratio, then earlier first frame.
query_triplet.roles: First two frames are initial observations; third is the fixed NEXT_FRAME_FORWARD action observation.

next_action.evaluable: Stop the queue, freeze the selected row's three references and ordered query triplet, then run the unchanged scorer once before applying the unchanged 0.02 truth-free trigger.
next_action.not_evaluable: Retain all six source-negative rows and move to an independently sourced trajectory panel rather than changing the admission rules.

forbidden_after_freeze: reorder, skip, replace or continue past queue rows based on source geometry or future model output
open RGB or call any model during source screening
change view rules, reference fill, triplet ranking, sibling requirement, trigger threshold, action or one-action budget
turn a network/download failure into a source-negative conclusion
claim_boundary: This run can establish only official-file integrity and fresh ordered pose/depth source evaluability. It is not RGB/model evidence, active-view success, a deployable selector, exact-instance binding, portal ownership, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
